extDescription.message: Lean, modern ad blocker: blocks ads and trackers, rejects cookie banners and shows exactly what it blocked.

appDescription.message: Lean, modern ad blocker for your browser.

siteUnavailable.message: AdLess does not work on this page.

tooManyLists.message: At most $1 lists can be active at the same time.

resetGroupHint.message: Restore the lists of this group and their default state

allListsHint.message: Turns on every list except languages and regions. Blocks the most, but a site breaks now and then. Turning it off restores the default lists.

groupEmpty.message: All lists of this group have been removed.

customListsHint.message: Add a filter list by its address. uBlock Origin, Adblock Plus and AdGuard syntax are supported. Lists are updated automatically.

errorDuplicate.message: This list has already been added.

errorInvalidUrl.message: Please enter a valid http(s) address.

rulesHint.message: One filter per line in uBlock Origin syntax, lines starting with ! are comments.

pickedHint.message: Created with “Hide element” in the popup.

allowlistHint.message: AdLess is paused on these sites. One domain per line; subdomains are included.

enableAdLessHint.message: Turns AdLess on or off on all sites.

exportHint.message: Saves filter lists, rules, hidden elements and allowlist to a file.

importHint.message: Replaces the current settings with a saved file.

importFailed.message: The file is not a valid AdLess backup.

creditsText.message: The filtering engine contains code from uBlock Origin Lite (© Raymond Hill, GPL-3.0), cookie banners are answered with autoconsent by DuckDuckGo (MPL-2.0). The filter lists come from their authors: EasyList, uBlock filters, AdGuard, Peter Lowe and many regional lists. Thank you!

upToDate.message: AdLess is up to date, your own lists have been reloaded. The included filter lists are renewed with every AdLess version.

updateInstalling.message: Installing AdLess $1 with new filter lists …

updateThrottled.message: Your own lists have been reloaded. The browser allows only a few update checks in a row, please try again later.

updateNotFromStore.message: Your own lists have been reloaded. This copy of AdLess was not installed from a store, so it cannot look for new versions.

reportProblemHint.message: Ads still visible or the page does not work? Opens a prefilled report on GitHub.

cookieBannersHint.message: Answers cookie banners with "reject" on its own, or hides them where there is no such button. Not on sites where AdLess is switched off.

ownListHint.message: Own fixes for sites in Germany, Austria and Switzerland, from the reports of AdLess users. Updated twice a day.

ownListBundled.message: $1 filters · from this AdLess version, not downloaded yet
